statement: The Logitech DJ child HID raw-request path rewrites supported HID++ messages with the child's device index and forwards them through the shared receiver HID++ interface; LED requests are also routed by receiver type. For an already removed child there is no surviving child HID request endpoint, while in-flight output delivery under loss is not verified.

applicability.scope: Logitech DJ consumer per-child output dispatch and absent-child API boundary
